description: Four mono equal power cross-faders, which two LINK buttons join into a pair of stereo cross-faders.

params.text: Sets the range the CV input is read over: unipolar 0-10V or bipolar -5V to 5V.
Picks the gain profile: linear, which gives 50% of each signal at the halfway point, logarithmic, which gives about 70%, or automatic, which chooses from the correlation of the two inputs.
Sweeps the output from all of the A input, through a mix, to all of the B input; it stops working while the CV input is patched.
Links a pair of mono cross-faders into one stereo cross-fader: the first fader's jacks carry the left channel and the second's carry the right; the second fader's other controls stop working.

inputs.text: One of the two signals mixed into that fader's output.
Takes the fade over from the knob, read across the range set by the CV mode switch.

outputs.text: The mix of that fader's two inputs at its current fade position.

notes: in automatic mode the AUTO light turns red when the two inputs are negatively correlated, which risks them cancelling in the mix; inverting one of the two clears it.
the automatic profile selector has hysteresis built in so that it does not flutter between the two profiles.
with a pair of faders linked, the correlation for automatic profile selection is measured on the left channel alone.
menu: Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
